newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: S.African wool prices fall at latest auction.
newsitem.headline: S.African wool prices fall at latest auction.

text.p: South African wool prices fell at the latest weekly auction, the Wool Board said.
It said 14,933 bales were offered at this week's sale, of which 95.5 percent was sold.

Price quotes for long Merino fleeces of 20 micron fell 4.7 percent, 21 micron fell 3.2 percent, 22 micron fell 4.5 percent, 23 micron fell 4.4 percent, 24 micron fell 4.3 percent and 25 micron fell 3.7 percent.
Prices for Merino bellies fell 3.1 percent, Merino lambs fell 4.9 percent and Merino locks fell 3.3 percent.
The offering included 2,325 bales of other White Wools, 53 bales of Ciskei/Transkei, 72 bales of Lesotho and 462 bales of coarse and coloured.
Of the 622 bales of 20 micron offered, 91.3 percent was sold. Of the 1,510 bales of 21 micron offered, 97.1 percent was sold. Of 2,828 bales of 22 micron offered, 95 percent was sold,
Of 2,253 bales of 23 micron offered, 93 percent was sold. Of the 815 bales of 24 micron offered, 91.2 percent was sold and of the 297 bales of 25 micron was offered, 87.2 percent was sold.
The next sale will take place on 20 November, when 10,000 bales will be on offer.
